read.passage: Faisal is fifteen, and he has been building small robots since he was ten. His first robot was made from old toy cars and a broken phone. "It could only move forward," he laughs. For the last two years, he has been working on a robot that helps farmers in Al-Qassim. It is designed to check the soil and tell farmers when their palm trees need water. The robot was tested on his uncle's farm last spring, and it was chosen as one of the best projects at a national science fair. "If I had more money, I'd build ten more," Faisal says. "I wish every farmer could use one. It would save so much water."
